overall: The draft is clean on the tokenizer (checker: 421/421 items pass, all 120 pool tokens listed) and most of the general vocabulary items are good: true, well known, varied and heroin-free. The main problems sit at the opioid edge. 'adone' (methadone) and 'oxone' (naloxone/Suboxone) live only in heroin-treatment drug names and should be exclusive, and ' opi' (only 'opiates') and 'ioid' (only 'Opioid') should be exclusive too, or at least lose their class-membership items. Items that lean on opioid pharmacology or opiate history (Serturner and morphine, codeine-to-morphine metabolism, opioid constipation, OxyContin/Purdue, fentanyl potency vs morphine, laudanum) give a heroin-knowing model an edge and are dropped or need replacing. Cross-token repeats are common (codeine x4, endorphins x3, constipation x2, Escobar x2, PCA x2, acetaminophen-liver x2, Afghan Girl x2, narcocorridos x2, Morpheus x2, tobacco x3). A few items force the token with unnatural quotes ('"Prescription" glasses', '"Anti-Smoking"', '"Moravia"') or use giveaway distractors and unstable facts (pharmaceutical items 2 and 4). 38 multi tokens have fewer than 4 items. For full words like ' Cartel', ' syringe(s)', ' poppy', ' euphoria', ' sedation', ' Opium', ' Substances' and ' carte' this is avoidable, and 'phine' should be rebuilt on Delphine/dauphine.
